summary: ZoneTrack MVP tested end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass (auth register/login/me + 401 gating, zones list/create/get/404, activities create+persist+list+soft-delete+404-after-delete, leaderboard distance+pace with type filter, profile stats). Frontend (mobile viewport 375x667): login screen renders with all required testIDs, tab-login/tab-signup switch works, email/password login succeeds and navigates to Zones tab, 6 zone-card testIDs render (5 seed + 1 auto), tapping a card opens /zone/[id] with back-btn + compete-btn, bottom tabs (Zonas/Registrar/Ranking/Perfil) all reachable, Record tab correctly shows permission gate with grant-location testID (browser cannot grant real GPS — verified graceful handling as instructed), Leaderboard shows empty state with go-to-zones when no zone selected, Profile renders stats + logout-btn, logout returns to /login (navigation gate honored). Dark theme + neon green accent look clean and consistent. No deprecated Expo packages detected.
action_items: None blocking. Optional: Record tab shows metric/filter testIDs only when a zone is selected; leaderboard metric-distance/metric-pace and filter-* testIDs likewise only render after selecting a zone. That is intentional per code, but if you want direct-URL testability, consider always rendering the controls with a disabled state. Not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `datetime.utcnow`-style usage avoided (uses timezone-aware now_utc) — good.
MongoDB _id is projected out in all reads (`{"_id": 0}`) — good.
All backend env vars (MONGO_URL/DB_NAME/JWT_SECRET/EMERGENT_AUTH_URL) read via os.environ without defaults — fail-fast, good.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL for API base — good.
All interactive UI elements carry testID props matching the spec.
public_user() dict may leak `created_at` as string; harmless.
seed_data_creation: Backend seed zones auto-inserted on startup (5 predefined). Test users created via /api/auth/register with TEST_ prefix and cleaned up implicitly (unique emails). Test activities soft-deleted after creation to keep DB clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test seed user: ana@test.com / secret123. Backend base = EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL + /api. Real GPS cannot be granted in headless Chromium so Record tab always shows the permission gate — this is expected and correctly handled by the app.
